summary: Iteration 7 backend regression after 4200→576 line server.py refactor + new seminar registration feature. 28/29 tests passed (96.5%). SEO 404 bug fix verified (sitemap.xml + robots.txt both 200). NEW seminar registration works end-to-end: POST /api/register/guest with visit_type='seminar' bypasses invite_code and capacity, saves seminar_slug/seminar_title, and GET /api/admin/guests?visit_type=seminar returns only seminar rows. Summit/fair filters remain correct and do not leak seminar records. However the refactor LEFT 3 MISSING IMPORTS that cause 1 hard 500 and 2 silent background-task failures.

critical.issue: Returns 500 NameError: name 'html_escape' is not defined. /app/backend/routes/badge.py uses html_escape.escape() but never imports it. Fix: add `import html as html_escape` at top of routes/badge.py.

Registration returns 200 but badge PNG attachment and Visitego push never happen. Backend log: `routes.registration - ERROR - Badge PNG generation failed on register: name 'render_badge_png' is not defined` and `Failed to schedule visitego push: name 'visitego_service' is not defined`. Fix routes/registration.py: `from routes.badge import render_badge_png` (or move helper) and `from services import visitego as visitego_service`. Users will NOT receive the badge PNG email attachment.

Endpoints return 200 with sent count, but internally every guest fails. Backend log: `routes.crm - ERROR - Failed to render badge attachment: name 'render_badge_png' is not defined` and `bulk-send-reminder failed ... name 'html_escape' is not defined`. Fix routes/crm.py: add `import html as html_escape` and import render_badge_png. Admin's 'Resend Badge' / 'Send Reminder' buttons silently send emails WITHOUT attachments and reminder email body fails to render at all.

action_items: [CRITICAL] routes/badge.py — add `import html as html_escape` (line ~90 uses html_escape.escape without import) → unblocks GET /api/badge/{id}.

[CRITICAL] routes/registration.py — import render_badge_png (from routes.badge) and `from services import visitego as visitego_service`. Otherwise badge attachment + visitego push never fire on registration.
[CRITICAL] routes/crm.py — same two imports (`html as html_escape`, `render_badge_png`). Affects /admin/guests/{id}/resend-badge, send-reminder, and both bulk variants.

Note for E1: the review request listed paths /api/seminer, /api/seminer/categories, /api/bulten, /api/family — these do NOT exist; actual paths are /api/academy/courses, /api/academy/categories, /api/newsletter/subscribe (POST), /api/family/settings. Tests now use the real paths and pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor introduced 3 missing-import regressions because helpers (render_badge_png, html_escape, visitego_service) were left in caller files instead of being re-imported in each extracted router module. Consider a `routes/_shared.py` for these helpers, or add a smoke startup-time check that imports each router and lints it.

Background-task exception handlers in registration.py and crm.py swallow NameError → API returns 200 while feature is completely broken. Recommend re-raising on NameError/ImportError so the regression is caught immediately.
routes/registration.py:255-265 — `render_badge_png` is referenced inside `register_guest` but only defined in routes/badge.py. Must be imported explicitly.
routes/crm.py:313, 376 — same issue; both `_build_badge_attachment` and `render_reminder_email` reference unimported names.
seed_data_creation: Test guests created with TEST_ prefix were auto-cleaned via /api/admin/guests/bulk-delete in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 adds the 3 missing imports (html as html_escape in badge.py & crm.py; render_badge_png + visitego_service in registration.py; render_badge_png in crm.py), rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_regression.py` — should be 29/29. Also do a manual check: after POST /api/register/guest, look at backend.err.log for ANY ERROR lines (should be none); on admin dashboard, click 'Resend Badge' on a guest → log should be clean.
rca of the issue: During the 4200→576 line server.py refactor, three helpers (render_badge_png defined only in routes/badge.py; html_escape = `import html as html_escape` at top of original server.py; visitego_service module) remained referenced by extracted router files (routes/registration.py, routes/crm.py, routes/badge.py) but their imports were not propagated to those new files. Because Python's NameError occurs only at call-time AND two of three call sites are wrapped in try/except inside background tasks, the bugs surface as silent 200 responses with broken side-effects, except /api/badge/{id} where the NameError happens in the request path and surfaces as 500.
